summary: Set `metrics_utility_enabled=true` under [automationcontroller] in the containerized inventory to deploy two automation-controller-metrics-utility containers (gather and report), and configure reporting with metrics_utility_extra_settings.
questions: How do I enable metrics-utility in the containerized inventory file?
Why are there two metrics-utility containers?

answer_card.title: Enable metrics-utility (containerized)
answer_card.answer_md:
In the inventory, under `[automationcontroller]`:
```ini
metrics_utility_enabled=true
```
This creates two `automation-controller-metrics-utility` containers (gather + build report). Tune location and content with `metrics_utility_extra_settings`. Re-run the installer on an existing deployment.
